design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: a commercial PPO member whose new Tandem Mobi pump (2026-10-02) will not pair with her Libre 2 Plus asks for her first Dexcom G7 sensors today. The refill waits on three unmet states: no grant rests on the G7 order of 2026-10-06 (agent write under the payer PA still in force), 95.54 is past due with no approved plan (customer accepts a plan), and the delivery has a unit the payer is expected not to pay (customer signs a plan member waiver, whose units are fixed only once the grant and the plan stand).
SCOPE: task 1 claims cgm_ext_model_change_authorization_units (record_model_change_authorization_2da97677, agent), cgm_ext_payment_plan_installment (accept_payment_plan_9d194c19, user), cgm_ext_plan_member_waiver_units (sign_plan_member_waiver_eca832b6, user) and cgm_ext_model_change_refill_units (ship_sensor_refill_e9d57917, agent); task 0 holds the Original Medicare renewal grant and advance notice - disjoint policies and tools.
DRAW: draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [6, 6, 4, 6]; grant 4, plan 6, waiver 6, refill 6.
PROBLEM TREE: root = refill (on_request). Edges: refill -> grant (value_input, drawn_grant_id, 'draws no units until ... stands recorded'); refill -> plan (state_gate, uncovered_past_due, 'does not ship until ... is below'); refill -> waiver (value_input, coverage_rule, 'ship only after a plan member waiver ... stands signed'); waiver -> grant (value_input, delivery_blocks, 'fixed only once ... stands recorded'); waiver -> plan (state_gate, uncovered_past_due, 'fixed only once the past-due amount ... is below'). 3 value_input edges >= max(3-1,1). Each state is brought about by exactly one write: only an authorization grant resting on the G7 order, only an approved payment plan request, only a liability notice of type plan_member_waiver dated on or after the order (compute and edge condition filter that type). Deletion runs: refill without grant/plan/waiver = {'grant': 0, 'plan': 0, 'waiver': 0}; waiver without grant/plan = {'grant': 0, 'plan': 0}.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: grant step - written_order_on_file and initial_visit_on_file hold. Plan step - the account policy's gates govern balance adjustments only. Waiver step - the base clause that the customer signs the notice personally applies to this waiver and is met by her own signing call; no route-around is claimed for this waiver. Refill step - program_active, authorization_valid_on_ship_date (new grant 2026-10-06..2027-02-10), units_within_authorization (2 + 4 = 6 >= 3), coverage_recently_verified (2026-08-20), receiver_interval (no receiver), followup_visit_current (most recent qualifying visit 2025-12-19), no_duplicate_sensor_source (Mobi) hold; refill_not_too_early and customer_confirmation are retired by self-scoped overwrites.
OVERWRITES: grant - the PA-tier recording clause, replaced only for a model-changing order under a PA in force, the rest carried verbatim. Plan - the plan clause carried verbatim (including 'while an approved plan's installments are current') and extended only for plans this policy prices. Refill - the lead-day timing clause, the confirmation clause and the supply-days clause, each replaced only for refills this policy counts. Refill and waiver - the past_due_balance clause of the holds policy, replaced only for their shared ship-time past-due test: whole calendar months of past_due_hold_days / 30, no test where past_due_hold_days is 0, past-due remittances other than a hardship-named posting covered only while an approved plan's installments are current (the base wording, computed as payments within the plan's months reaching its monthly amount per elapsed month), and a hardship-named posting set aside per the hardship rules; both siblings carry the same replaced_by naming both, and every program hold still rests on the base clause.
FOLLOW-UP VISIT: the grant measures the lapse from the visit the base requirement uses (most recent qualifying visit 2025-12-19) with the base boundary implemented exactly: a visit is current on a date when the calendar-month difference is below the interval, or equals it and the visit's calendar day is on or after the date's, or the visit falls on the last day of its month (counting back from a day that does not exist lands on the month's last day). The compute derives the visit month's last day (leap years included) and tests month-end with fixed reference dates, so no month-end case differs from the base count. The cut itself counts whole calendar months from the visit to the valid-through date by the convention every policy now states: the calendar-month difference, less one when the later date's calendar day is earlier.
UNITS AT RISK: defined once in each of the waiver and refill rules as (at-risk blocks less excepted blocks) x allowance; the units beyond the payer authorization are a separate quantity. The waiver lists units at risk only by default, adds the units beyond the payer authorization under the listing tier, and the refill ships less exposed units (units at risk plus units beyond) not covered by the waiver. Single reading: waiver = 0 + 1 = 1.
EXCEPTION CONSISTENCY: a pump-required documented change (superseded supply unusable, as the grant policy also states) gets the larger relief (up to two at-risk blocks); a documented clinical change without a pump change gets the first block only.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: G7 order 07ad70dc-c3f6-4670-ad68-2dfe46535402 (2026-10-06..2027-10-05, qty 3); GR-B (11 units, 2026-03-06..2027-02-10, per-period, 9 drawn, 2 left); latest refill (2026-09-21, 90 days, remittance 2026-10-10, payer paid 284.16); over-limit justification 2026-10-06; hardship application 2026-09-28 on the 355.20 remittance; expedited charge 24.50; pump: Mobi delivered 2026-10-02, balance 454.76, pump plan 6 x 39.40 with 5 paid.
FACTOR CARD (grant): prescribed_quantity_reading (method): quantity 3 = 1 x 3 -> 1 per block; baseline (as written 3) gives 12. | superseded_supply_overlap (parameter, cross pump): pump active, Mobi delivered 2026-10-02 after the 2026-09-21 refill, justification 2026-10-06 -> 0 deducted; baseline (whole blocks of the 75 days past the order date = 2) gives 2. | approval_period_count (method): GR-B 11 units = 11 whole blocks of 2026-03-06..2027-02-10 (342 days) -> per-period: blocks begun over 128 days = 5; baseline (whole blocks 4) gives 3. | follow_up_lapse_cut (parameter): PPO interval 12; most recent qualifying visit 2025-12-19 is 9 months before the order date; MONTHS(2025-12-19, 2027-02-10) = 13 -> 1 block removed; baseline (no shortening) gives 5. | plain: span 2026-10-06..2027-02-10 (the earlier of GR-B's and the order's valid-through); result = 1 x (5 - 0 - 1) = 4.
FACTOR CARD (plan): hardship_pending_carve_out (parameter): application of 2026-09-28 received, names the 355.20 remittance -> left out; baseline gives 87.18. | convenience_charge_carve_out (parameter): expedited charge 24.50 -> left out; baseline gives 32.06. | statement_cycle_window (method): remittance posted 2026-10-10 within the last calendar month -> recent remittances and charges wait: CGM 71.04, pump 318.56 (2026-10-13); baseline (nothing waits) gives 92.91. | pump_balance_fold (parameter, cross pump): pump active on the same coverage -> pump balance 454.76 taken in; baseline gives 0.00 (plan balance 71.04 below 150.00). | pump_plan_carve_out (parameter, cross pump): pump plan logged 2026-05-06, 5 whole months, payments within those months 5 x 39.40 = 197.00 >= 5 x 39.40 -> current; 236.40 - 197.00 = 39.40 left out; baseline gives 34.54. | installment_rounding (method): latest CGM payment by debit card -> round up to the cent: 167.84 / 6 = 27.9733 -> 27.98; baseline (nearest cent) gives 27.97. | plain: plan balance = 521.78 - 355.20 - 24.50 - 71.04 + (454.76 - 318.56 - 39.40) = 167.84 >= 150.00; installment 27.98 >= 25.00.
FACTOR CARD (waiver, after grant and plan): waiver_refill_timing (method, cross pump): Mobi delivered 2026-10-02 after 2026-09-21 and on or before 2026-10-06 -> may ship today; baseline (2026-12-10) gives 0. | waiver_hardship_set_aside (parameter): application awaiting decision -> 355.20 set aside; baseline: 379.70 >= 75.00, cannot ship, gives 0. | early_refill_allowance (parameter): 90 days -> 18 days; baseline (0: 3 frequency blocks, 2 excepted, 1 at risk + 1 beyond) gives 2. | frequency_edit_rule (method): payer paid 284.16 -> blocks beginning before 66 - 18 = 48 days: 2; baseline (whole delivery: 3) gives 2. | documented_change_exception (method, cross pump): pump-required change documented -> up to the first two at-risk blocks excepted (2); baseline (none) gives 3. | waiver_listing_scope (method): delivery on the new grant, GR-B has 2 units left < 3 -> units at risk 0 plus 1 beyond the payer authorization; baseline (units at risk only) gives 0. | plain: delivery 3 blocks; units at risk (2 - 2) x 1 = 0; units beyond the payer authorization 3 - 2 = 1; uncovered past-due 24.50 < 75.00 (plan current); result = 1.
FACTOR CARD (refill, after all prerequisites): superseded_refill_timing (method, cross pump): pump-forced change -> ship today; baseline gives 0. | hardship_pending_exclusion (parameter): 355.20 set aside; baseline (379.70 >= 75.00) gives 0. | refill_early_allowance (parameter): 18 days; baseline (0: exposed units 2 > waiver 1) gives 2. | refill_frequency_rule (method): block-start rule -> 2 blocks; baseline (whole delivery: exposed 2) gives 2. | refill_change_exception (method, cross pump): both at-risk blocks excepted; baseline (none: exposed 3) gives 1. | waiver_coverage_rule (method): plan member waiver 2026-10-15 on or after 2026-10-06 covers 1 unit; baseline (ships only with no exposed units) gives 0. | plain: exposed units = 0 at risk + 1 beyond = 1 <= waiver 1 -> ships 3 units.
FACTOR LADDER TABLE (tiers / condition / reachable domain / distinguishing input; no tier carries a conjunct true for every customer in scope; fall-through = declared baseline): prescribed_quantity_reading a qty = allowance x blocks / b other qty above allowance / c as written; inputs 3 / 2 / 1. superseded_supply_overlap a pump delivered after the latest refill with a justification on or after it / b per-period PA with supply past the order date / c otherwise; 75 overlap days give 0 / 3 / 2. approval_period_count a per-period PA / b PA units below its span blocks / c PA units above them; 128 days give 5 / min(4, left) / 4. follow_up_lapse_cut a visit current on the order date and not on the valid-through date / b visit not current on the order date / c current through the valid-through date; visits 2025-12-19 / 2025-10-05 / 2026-02-10 give cut 1 / no units / 0. Plan: hardship a received / b approved / c none; charges a expedited / b standard shipping / c none; statement a remittance less than a month old / b only a charge less than a month old / c none; pump fold a open on the same coverage (whole balance) / b open on another coverage (charges, never more than its balance) / c closed or none; pump plan a current / b behind (installments not yet due) / c none; rounding a card (27.98) / b check or ACH (28.00) / c none (27.97). Waiver and refill: timing a pump-forced / b expedited_no_charge latest refill (from its POD date) / c base lead days; hardship a/b/c as the plan; early allowance a >= standard supply (18) / b 30..89 days (lead days) / c none; frequency a payer paid any amount (block start: 2) / b remitted with no payment (first block: 1) / c otherwise (whole delivery: 3); exception a pump transition (up to two) / b clinical change (first) / c none, separated by 2 frequency blocks; waiver listing a carried grant with PA units left below the delivery (at risk + beyond: 1) / b latest refill unconfirmed (whole delivery: 3) / c at risk only (0); waiver coverage a waiver on or after the order (covers its units) / b older waiver (ships less exposed) / c none (ships only with no exposed units).
ROUND-8 ORDER CARD: the waiver and refill result sentences fix the order - the earliest ship date and the paid-supply end are moved or replaced first, the at-risk blocks are marked against the moved end, blocks are then taken off, and the listing (refill: the waiting rule) is replaced last; reading the unmoved end (waiver 2) is excluded by the text. The model-change grant states replacements first, then blocks taken off. N9: the pump-plan adjustment applies only when the insulin pump program bills the same coverage record, and the plan's result sentence takes amounts off another program's postings only from the amount added from that program, never below zero (the statement adjustment's pump part likewise); probes: pump program closed -> plan balance 71.04 -> no plan; pump on another coverage record with no charges -> 71.04 -> no plan; task world 167.84 -> 27.98. ROUND-7 XF CARD: each rule is a standard-method paragraph in record terms (baseline names no factor quantity or zero default), shared plain quantities defined once (next delivery, latest refill and paid-supply end, payer authorization and the units beyond it, pump delivery and over-limit justification, past-due and plan coverage; for the plan the unpaid balance, recent postings and the pump coverage match), self-contained adjustment sentences, and one generic result sentence; the waiver and refill baselines carry no early-refill allowance or excepted blocks, and the plan's replaced_by scope no longer names the pump program. Values and sensitivities unchanged. Mechanical check: cgm_ext_renewal_authorization_units: non-factor/baseline factor-term hits=none; result hits=none; factor-reads-factor=none | cgm_ext_medicare_advance_notice_units: non-factor/baseline factor-term hits=none; result hits=none; factor-reads-factor=none | cgm_ext_model_change_authorization_units: non-factor/baseline factor-term hits=none; result hits=none; factor-reads-factor=none | cgm_ext_plan_member_waiver_units: non-factor/baseline factor-term hits=none; result hits=none; factor-reads-factor=none | cgm_ext_payment_plan_installment: non-factor/baseline factor-term hits=none; result hits=none; factor-reads-factor=none | cgm_ext_model_change_refill_units: non-factor/baseline factor-term hits=none; result hits=none; factor-reads-factor=none. ROUND-5 SOURCE CARD: the holds replaced_by names the sibling counts by their general subjects (the refill count for a delivery drawing on the grant resting on the newest written order, the plan member waiver count); the paid-supply end is a standard quantity (ship date + paid supply days) that the early-refill adjustment moves earlier and the frequency-edit adjustment reads; the plan balance is the standard unpaid balance that each adjustment changes on its own (hardship, delivery charges and statement waits taken off, the pump balance added, the pump plan's uncollected installments taken off), the statement adjustment reading the pump coverage record itself; past_due_hold_days / 30 is rounded down; the plan covers past-due remittances only while the program's patient payments keep its installments current; a missing proof of delivery falls back to the ship date; half cents round to the even cent. Probes: pump program on another coverage record -> charges-only branch (none on file) -> plan balance 71.04 -> no plan; pump program closed -> nothing taken in -> no plan. FACTOR INDEPENDENCE (transitive read check, run on the charter, round 5: no violation in any of the six policies): for every factor of every policy, the names its bindings read were followed through plain bindings; none reaches a binding owned by another factor. Shared selections (insulin stopped, pump delivery, justification date, units at risk inputs) are plain bindings stated once in the rule.
BOUNDARY PROBES: follow-up currency on interval 6 - visit 2026-02-28 / order 2026-08-31 current (Feb month end), 2026-02-27 not; 2026-03-31 and 2026-03-30 / order 2026-09-30 current, 2026-03-29 not; leap 2028-02-29 / 2028-08-31 current, 2028-02-28 not; 2025-08-31 and 2025-08-30 / 2026-02-28 current, 2025-08-27 not; interval 12 - 2027-02-28 / 2028-02-29 current, 2027-02-27 not; 2024-02-29 / 2025-02-28 current; 2025-10-06 / 2026-10-06 current, 2025-10-05 not; no visit on file not current. On this world: visit exactly 12 months before the order date (2025-10-06) -> grant 1 (cut 4); 2025-10-05 -> 0 units; visit exactly 12 months before the valid-through date (2026-02-10) -> no cut; earliest ship date equal to today ships; a posting with fewer than one whole calendar month to today waits for the statement; a posting with past_due_hold_days/30 whole calendar months to today counts as past due; waiver dated on the order date covers. MONTHS SWEEP: every other month comparison in the six policies (coverage review months left, notice credit 12-month window, past-due window, plan currency, statement window, pump plan age) uses the whole-calendar-month convention stated in its own rule, which is exactly what the compute evaluates.
EDGE PROBES: no grant on the newest order -> delivery 0, waiver 0, refill 0; no pump program -> CFIELD None -> base timing, no exception, no fold; a decoy ABN or an older plan member waiver is not this delivery's waiver; no remittance -> frequency rule falls through; plan approved but behind on installments -> not covered, the refill is held; no payment on file -> nearest-cent rounding; no hardship application -> nothing set aside; plan balance below 150.00 or installment below 25.00 -> 0.00; past_due_hold_days 0 (Medicaid) -> never held; payment_plan_max_months 6 on PPO (no zero division); allowance >= 1 on every tier; decoys: GR-A (exhausted), Libre orders, the 2022 t:slim chain, the April pump posting already on the pump plan.
PERSONA: volunteers only the goal (first Dexcom G7 sensors shipped today) and identifiers on request (6145550163, 1986-04-19, 43215); facts on request; passive hold and acceptance of whatever she is handed.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate, verify, read CGM program/coverage/orders/shipments/billing/requests and the pump program, orders, shipments, billing and requests; record the grant (4 units, SVC-PA-2026-118394, 2026-10-06..2027-02-10); customer accepts 6 x 27.98; customer signs the waiver for 1 unit of A4239; ship 3 units / 9 sensors / 90 days on the new grant.
VERIFICATION: authoring harness reproducing check_compute bindings gave grant=4 (all-baseline 6), plan=27.98 (all-baseline 86.96), waiver=1 (all-baseline 0), refill=3 (all-baseline 0).
user_scenario: You are Rosalind Vantongeren, 40, a hospital pharmacy buyer in Columbus, Ohio, with type 1 diabetes. Larkfield Medical Supply has shipped your FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus sensors every three months under your Scioto Valley Choice PPO plan, and it also supplies your insulin pump. Your new Tandem Mobi pump arrived on October 2, and it will not pair with the Libre 2 Plus, so your endocrinologist sent Larkfield a new order for the Dexcom G7 on October 6. You are calling because you want your first box of Dexcom G7 sensors shipped today, so the Mobi can run on automatic mode again. When the representative asks how to find your account you give the phone number on file, 6145550163; to confirm who you are you give your date of birth, 1986-04-19, and your ZIP code, 43215, and you offer your email r.vantongeren@buckeyeweb.net only if they still need another detail. You answer other questions only when asked: you are still wearing a Libre 2 Plus on its own with the phone app and have about a month of those sensors left, which you will keep as a backup; you use the CGM every day; you have not been in a hospital or nursing facility; at the end of September you sent Larkfield a financial hardship application about the big deductible bill from the spring and have not heard back; you know there are some older bills on your account and you pay by debit card. If the representative says something has to be set up or updated on their side first, you are glad to hold while they do it. If the representative explains that you need to sign or accept something yourself before the sensors can ship, you listen to what it is and accept it exactly as they give it to you, and you ask them to read back what you accepted. You do not know your plan's rules or how many units or dollars should be involved; if a number sounds odd to you, you only ask them to double-check it against your records, without suggesting a figure. Once they tell you the sensors have shipped, you thank them and say goodbye.
